department: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering

deadline.value: Doctoral applications for fall entry should reach admissions by February 15; the catalog says applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student gets an academic advisor after admission; the catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: All students pursuing a doctoral degree will have an academic advisor (and co-advisor, if applicable) who must be a member of the Missouri S&T graduate faculty.

funding.value: The catalog gives no funding statement for the PhD.

entry_route.value: A PhD normally follows 72 semester hours beyond the B.S. or 42 hours beyond the M.S.
entry_route.quote: A student pursuing the doctor of philosophy degree normally follows a program of 72 semester hours beyond the B.S. | degree or 42 semester hours beyond the M.S.
